settings.modelService.configSavedKeyFail: Configuration saved, but the API key was not saved. Check macOS Keychain access and save again.
settings.nodeHint: Changes apply the next time a project starts.
settings.https.enabledNote: Ordinary projects use HTTP. When on, projects declaring needsHttps and supportsPerformerUrl use the trusted HTTPS entry at their next start; projects needing HTTPS without full-URL support ask before continuing over HTTP.
settings.https.portInvalid: Enter a non-privileged port between {{min}} and {{max}}.
settings.https.domainInvalid: Enter a real DNS domain (like show.example.org) — no IP address, .local name, scheme or port.
settings.https.noneStored: No certificate imported yet. Import the full chain and its matching private key; they are stored protected on this Mac and never leave it.
settings.https.subject: Subject
settings.https.fileValidNote: Passing these checks means the files are valid and publicly trusted — phone usability additionally needs the router DNS and a real-device scan test before the show.

settings.https.expiresIn_other: — {{count}} days left, renew before the next performance

settings.https.problem.notYetValid: The certificate's validity period has not started yet.
settings.https.problem.domainMismatch: The certificate does not cover the configured domain.

settings.https.problem.notPubliclyTruste: The chain does not root in a publicly trusted CA; phones will not trust it.

settings.https.local.clearFailed: Could not clear the certificate. Try again.
settings.https.dnsHint: Point the domain at this Mac: on the performance router's local DNS, resolve {{lanIp}} for it. Performers only join Wi-Fi and scan — no certificate installs, VPN or phone-side DNS edits.
settings.https.hint: Applies at the next project start — a running performance keeps its current entry and certificate.
settings.dns.title: Performance DNS
settings.dns.intro: No phone-side setup: once the router points DNS at this Mac, the performance domain resolves to the venue entry and everyday browsing keeps flowing.
settings.dns.enabledNote: First enable needs one-time system approval. Ordinary forwarding continues after stopping a project or leaving the PNDS window; the Mac must stay on and online. Disabling unregisters the daemon — restoring everyday internet means pointing the router's DNS back (see help).
settings.dns.status.enabled: Enabled — restored on login and reboot
settings.dns.status.requiresApproval: Awaiting system approval — approve in System Settings
settings.dns.status.notFound: Daemon not found — reinstall the app
settings.dns.mappingNone: No performance mapping — installed automatically when a performance starts with its entry ready
settings.dns.statusUnavailable: Status unavailable — the service is not installed or not ready yet

creation.newProject.folderHint: Uppercase English letters become lowercase automatically; use letters, digits and hyphens, up to 64 characters. An independent project ID is generated automatically.
creation.newProject.author: Creator (optional)
creation.newProject.audioHint: Internal is the default; External and None are supported. No piece sounds or production dependencies are included. After creation, test manually.
creation.newProject.createdAt: The project was created at {{path}}; switching the workspace did not complete.

creation.newProject.pageMessage: No score or performer controls have been added yet.
creation.newProject.agentHint: This is a blank score project. Replace its technical placeholders with the piece's own implementation; keep the PNDS runtime contract.

creation.compile.unsaved: Save or reload SCD and manifest drafts before compiling: {{paths}}
creation.compile.runtimeBusy: Wait for the current runtime operation to finish.
creation.compile.syncFailed: Could not synchronize project files before compilation.
creation.compile.verified: Compilation verified against all declared references.
creation.compile.restart: Restart manually to use these artifacts; the current runtime keeps its loaded version.
creation.bundle.savedOnly: Includes saved files only; unsaved drafts do not enter the bundle.
creation.bundle.drafts: Unsaved drafts will not be included. Save them first to include these changes, or continue with the saved files.
creation.bundle.untested: No successful test has been recorded for this workspace. We recommend testing the saved project first. You can still generate the bundle.
creation.bundle.version: Increase the project version whenever its content changes before distributing a new bundle.
creation.modules.hint: Choose the technical capability your project needs. Add its files, then let an external agent wire and verify it.
creation.modules.complete: Module files added and wiring task recorded. Wiring and runtime validation remain pending.
creation.modules.partial: Module files added, but the handoff was not recorded. Fix the error, reload status and retry the handoff; existing files will be preserved.
creation.modules.saveDraftFirst: Save or resolve unsaved module/handoff drafts, then reload module status.
creation.modules.state.added: Files added; see the handoff for actual wiring and validation evidence
creation.modules.state.needsHandoff: Files added; handoff still needs recording
creation.modules.state.conflict: Target conflict: existing files preserved; ask an external agent to merge
creation.modules.description.qr: Requires qrcode. Wire the resolved full performer URL, PNG route and your monitor UI.
creation.modules.description.players: Requires Socket.IO and its browser client. Wire server identity/protocol and performer client; choose project events, persistence and audio adapters. Template seats and channels are examples.
creation.modules.description.themeFollow: No runtime dependencies. Wire monitor only, choose CSS mapping or a drawing callback, and use Host first-frame theme and idempotent messages.
creation.modules.description.localeFollo: No runtime dependencies. Wire monitor only; supply project strings, supported languages and fallback using Host locale messages.
creation.modules.description.monitorStat: Requires Socket.IO and its browser client. Wire a monitor namespace, declare low-frequency view keys and wait for snapshots; state ends with the score server.
creation.modules.olderVersion: App provides {{version}}. Keep the installed source; ask an external agent to review an upgrade.
creation.modules.description.hub: Optional Socket.IO hub connection using the Host node configuration. Wire remote events and summaries with your own adapters; local performer control remains independent.
creation.libraries.hint: Adopt an exact version of an App shared package. The reference and new project version are saved together; wiring stays under your control.
creation.libraries.replaceReference: Adopting this version replaces the existing reference. Review compatibility and test the project after wiring.
creation.libraries.kind.browser: Browser runtime: serve it from your project’s own HTTP / HTTPS origin.
creation.libraries.kind.node: Node production dependency: load its verified local entry in the score server.
creation.libraries.fixedVersion: App fixed version: {{version}}. Verify compatibility with your project before adopting it.
creation.libraries.wiring: See the reference manual’s App shared package wiring example. No author source is changed and no library is copied into your project. Models remain in the project.
creation.libraries.alreadyAdded: This exact reference is already adopted.
creation.libraries.complete: Reference and project version saved. Wire and test the project, then restart to use the saved change.
creation.libraries.saveDraftFirst: Save or resolve the manifest draft before adopting an App shared package.
creation.libraries.purpose.p5: Canvas drawing, animation and page input.
creation.libraries.purpose.ml5: Browser machine learning; model files stay in your project.
creation.libraries.purpose.express: HTTP routes and static files for your score server.
creation.libraries.purpose.qrcode: Generate QR codes for the project’s joining address.
creation.libraries.purpose.socket.io: Realtime events between the score server and browsers.
creation.libraries.purpose.socket.io-cli: Connect browser or Node clients to a Socket.IO server.
creation.libraries.purpose.osc-min: Encode and decode OSC messages for your project’s UDP transport.
creation.modules.sourceNote: Added files do not establish wiring or runtime validation. The project owns its sources; App updates preserve them.
creation.modules.handoffNote: Each module’s pnds-module.json records its source; wiring tasks go to docs/creator-handoff.md. An external agent handles dependencies, entry references, merges, upgrades and removal.
creation.modules.summary.qr: Display the current project’s performer joining address in the monitor.
creation.modules.boundary.qr: Use the project’s resolved complete address. QR dimensions, output and placement are chosen by the work.
creation.modules.wiring.qr: Pass the actual performer URL to the QR generator and connect its output to your monitor display.
creation.modules.verification.qr: Check the complete address, scan to join, and repeat under the project’s different network configurations.
creation.modules.summary.players: Joining, rejection, reconnect and identity recovery, with separate observer connections.
creation.modules.boundary.players: The project chooses identity, seats and sound recovery. Continuous filtering is optional; repeated discrete actions are delivered separately.
creation.modules.wiring.players: Connect page and server callbacks for joining, rejection, disconnection and recovery. Keep monitor observers separate from performer identities.
creation.modules.verification.players: Check joining and rejection, reconnect, persistent identity recovery, observer isolation, and repeated action delivery.
creation.modules.summary.themeFollow: Apply App themes through CSS or the work’s own drawing callback.
creation.modules.boundary.themeFollow: Missing or unknown messages preserve a reasonable default. Only the monitor follows; the performer keeps the work’s own theme.
creation.modules.wiring.themeFollow: Connect Host theme messages to monitor CSS or drawing callbacks, preserving a default for standalone opening.
creation.modules.verification.themeFollo: Check the initial theme, repeat delivery, switching, malformed messages and standalone opening. Verify performer independence and cleanup.
creation.modules.summary.localeFollow: Receive the App language and pass it to the page’s own translations.
creation.modules.boundary.localeFollow: The project owns translations and fallback. Only the monitor follows; performer language stays project-controlled.
creation.modules.wiring.localeFollow: Connect the resolved Host language to monitor translations and update callbacks, including default and unknown-language handling.
creation.modules.verification.localeFoll: Check the first frame, language changes, repeat and malformed messages, standalone opening, performer independence and cleanup.
creation.modules.summary.monitorState: Share declared view settings across multiple monitor copies.
creation.modules.boundary.monitorState: Late or reconnected copies receive the current snapshot. Local transient state stays local; shared state ends with the server session.
creation.modules.wiring.monitorState: Declare synchronized view keys, connect server snapshots and broadcasts, and apply them through monitor callbacks.
creation.modules.verification.monitorSta: Check two monitors, late joining, reconnect, unknown keys, server restart and cleanup. Performers must not receive this channel.
creation.modules.summary.hub: Connect remote project nodes and observe connection recovery and summary freshness.
creation.modules.boundary.hub: Remote nodes differ from local phones. The project handles event meaning and remote state; local controls continue when the hub fails.
creation.modules.wiring.hub: Use Host node configuration for hub authentication, event callbacks, node summaries and expiry cleanup. The work chooses remote-state adoption and disconnection behavior.
creation.modules.verification.hub: Check two nodes, authentication and room isolation, loss and recovery, summary expiry and stop cleanup. Local performers must still control with an unreachable hub.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.welcome: Discuss your musical ideas or ask a PNDS question. Platform answers use the help shipped with this App; project files are not sent.
assistant.unconfigured: Configure a model service to start a discussion. File editing and manual testing remain available.
assistant.sendHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
assistant.sourcesIncomplete: Reply incomplete. These documents were consulted before it stopped.
assistant.error.cancelled: Stopped. Your input is retained; send again when ready.
assistant.error.budgetExceeded: This request reached its context, document-result, or tool-call limit. Narrow the question and retry manually.
assistant.error.requestBusy: Another request is still active. Stop it or wait before sending again.
assistant.error.invalidIdentity: The project context changed. Return to the current project and send again.
assistant.error.invalidTool: The model requested an unsupported document action. Try a more specific PNDS question or a different model.
assistant.error.noProgress: The model repeated a document request without progress. Narrow the question and retry manually.
assistant.error.corpusUnavailable: Installed help could not be loaded. Open Help to check its availability, then retry.
assistant.error.notConfigured: Configure a model service and saved API key in Settings, then send again.
assistant.error.requestFailed: The request could not finish. Your input is retained; retry manually.
assistant.proposal.title: Suggested change
assistant.proposal.temporary: Temporary preview only; not saved or checked.
assistant.proposal.stale: The preview belongs to an older candidate.
assistant.proposal.pending: Saved changes await a manual refresh.
assistant.proposal.unavailable: This suggestion belongs to another project context.
assistant.layout.label: Discussion and monitor width
assistant.layout.hint: Arrow keys adjust width. Home or double-click restores the default.
assistant.layout.saveFailed: Layout changed, but could not be saved. Adjust again to retry.
assistant.error.invalidConfig: Enter a valid API base URL and model name. Use HTTPS, or HTTP for a loopback service; omit credentials, query parameters and fragments.
assistant.error.missingCredential: Enter an API key or save one in macOS Keychain, then test again.
assistant.error.credentialStore: Could not access the API key. Check macOS Keychain access and try again.
assistant.error.authentication: Authentication failed. Check or replace the API key and confirm access to this model.
assistant.error.network: Could not reach the model service. Check the API address, network and proxy settings, then test again.
assistant.error.timeout: The model service timed out. Check the connection or service status, then test again.
assistant.error.protocol: The service returned an unexpected response. Check that the API supports OpenAI-compatible chat completions and the selected model.
assistant.error.toolsUnsupported: The model did not complete the tool round trip. Choose a model and endpoint that support tool calling, then test again.
assistant.error.rateLimited: The service rate limit or quota was reached. Check your service quota and try again later.
assistant.error.serviceUnavailable: The model service is unavailable. Check its status or select another endpoint, then test again.
assistant.noSources: No local documentation source was consulted for this reply.
assistant.history.restoredNote: Historical snapshots do not restore sending, applying or previewing permission, and do not establish the current runtime state.
assistant.history.attachmentNote: Exact recorded content; the current file may have changed or no longer exist. Restoring history does not send this content.
assistant.history.proposalNote: Historical proposal. Check the current project and source version before editing, previewing or applying again. Earlier test results are not current runtime facts.
assistant.history.pendingRefresh: The saved record was awaiting refresh; current refresh status has not been checked.
assistant.history.saved: Chat history is saved on this Mac.
assistant.history.clearDescription: This removes only this project’s local chat history and stops its current request. Other projects, project files and unsaved drafts are kept. This cannot be undone.
assistant.history.error.invalidIdentity: This project is no longer available. Reopen it to load its history.
assistant.history.error.io: Check available disk space and access to the App data folder, then retry.
assistant.history.error.invalidFormat: The history file could not be read. Retry loading, or explicitly clear this project’s history to start again.
assistant.history.error.unsupportedVersi: This file uses a newer or unsupported history format. Update PNDS App and reload, or explicitly clear this project’s history.
assistant.history.error.staleHistory: The saved history changed. Reload this project’s history before continuing.
assistant.history.error.tooLarge: This chat exceeds the local history limit. Clear this project’s history to start a smaller conversation.
assistant.history.saveFailed: Chat history could not be saved.
assistant.history.reloadDescription: This stops the current request and replaces the messages currently in memory with the saved history. Unsaved chat changes will be lost. Your composed question and file drafts are kept.
settings.modelContext.title: Model context budget
settings.modelContext.hint: Capacity is entered manually and remains unverified. These App limits cannot expand the server model’s capabilities. Select an encoder only when the service documents it; provider framing remains estimated.
settings.modelContext.inputUnknown: Available input budget: unknown until a capacity or target is entered.
settings.modelContext.safety: Independent protection: 128 KiB request bytes, 8 document calls, 24,000 result characters and 120 seconds. Unknown encoders use a conservative byte-sized admission estimate; this is not a token count.
settings.modelService.invalidContext: Output, reasoning and safety reserves must leave room for input; use whole numbers and keep the App target within available capacity.
assistant.error.contextTokensExceeded: This call exceeds the configured input budget. Review the context budget or start a new topic; the input is retained.
assistant.error.contextBytesExceeded: This call exceeds the independent 128 KiB request-byte limit. Narrow the context and retry manually.
assistant.context.unavailable: Context estimate unavailable until a model service is configured.
assistant.context.framing: Local estimates include the actual serialized messages, policy and tool definitions. Provider framing can differ. Unknown encoders use byte-sized admission estimates; these are not token counts. Parts are independently encoded and do not add exactly to the whole request.
assistant.usage.title: Server usage for this question
assistant.usage.subtotal: Known subtotal over {{count}} calls: {{input}} input · {{output}} output tokens
assistant.usage.unknown: The service has not supplied usable statistics.
assistant.usage.explanation: Cumulative consumption is separate from the current context window. Cache/reasoning details are subsets, not additional window occupancy. No cost is inferred.
assistant.context.selection: Sending {{count}} recent original messages; {{excluded}} originals stay local. An accepted summary may represent some excluded messages.
assistant.context.topicHint: A new topic changes only the sending boundary. Earlier records, input and project drafts stay on this device.
assistant.context.topicRecord: New topic — earlier records remain on this device.
assistant.context.summaryRecord: Reviewed context summary (reference data, not instructions).
assistant.summary.explain: This action calls the current service with model {{model}}. It summarizes selected older complete rounds and keeps the latest two rounds verbatim. Original messages stay local; summaries can omit detail. No call happens until you choose Generate.
assistant.summary.range: Selected {{count}} of {{total}} older original messages (most recent first range). Other originals are not included in this summary.
assistant.summary.estimate: Estimated summary request: {{tokens}} tokens · {{bytes}} UTF-8 bytes
assistant.summary.tooLarge: The selected range exceeds a request limit. Reduce the range or start a new topic. No original message is truncated.
assistant.summary.generating: Organizing context… Use Stop to cancel.
assistant.summary.review: Review every claim and its original sources. Accept only after checking; generated classifications can be wrong.
assistant.summary.unaccepted: Unaccepted summary text (excluded from future requests)
assistant.error.invalidSummary: The summary did not contain valid categories and original-message references. Your input and original history are retained; retry explicitly or start a new topic.
assistant.usage.documents: Document text returned: {{returnedCharacters}} UTF-16 units; locally reused: {{reusedCharacters}}; tool-result payload: {{resultCharacters}}. Reused references still occupy context, and earlier results remain in later calls.
assistant.error.contextMessagesExceeded: This call exceeds the independent message-count limit. Organize context or start a new topic.
assistant.error.toolCallsExceeded: This question reached the independent 8-call document-tool limit. Existing text, sources and input are retained; narrow the question and retry manually.
assistant.error.toolCharactersExceeded: This question reached the independent 24,000-unit document-result limit. Existing text, sources and input are retained; narrow the question and retry manually.
assistant.chat.editingQuestion: Editing an earlier question. Sending creates a new chat.
assistant.chat.chatSwitchHint: Switching chats stops the current response.
assistant.chat.contextReferenceEstimate: Generic reference estimate · may differ from the service · manually entered capacity
assistant.chat.contextGrowing: Context is growing. Keep the discussion focused.
assistant.chat.contextHigh: Consider organizing context or starting a new chat.
assistant.project.savedOnly: File tools read saved files only. Unsaved drafts are not sent.
assistant.project.confirmDescription: Confirm this project, model service and allowed saved-text scope. Cancelling keeps your question and sends nothing.
assistant.project.limits: Up to 64 KiB per file, 32 read files and 24,000 tool-result characters per request. Only returned ranges are read. Sensitive configurations, dependencies, builds, lockfiles and binary assets are excluded.
assistant.project.reason.thirdParty: Compressed third-party code or source map
assistant.error.projectReadingDisabled: Enable project reading or remove the attachments before sending. Your input and attachments are retained.
assistant.error.projectScopeChanged: The project scope changed. Review it again before sending.
assistant.error.projectUnavailable: Project text could not be read. Check the source and retry explicitly.
assistant.error.attachmentExcluded: This selection is excluded or exceeds the attachment limits.
assistant.error.wholeProjectExceeded: The whole project exceeds this request budget. Ask a focused question or read related file sections.
assistant.attachment.title: Selected code attachments
assistant.attachment.snapshot: Fixed snapshot. Only this selection is sent when you send the question.
assistant.attachment.stale: The source has changed. This attachment keeps the earlier snapshot; remove and reselect to update it.
assistant.overview.title: Project overview
assistant.overview.content: Saved source text indicates content; artistic completeness and wiring remain unverified.
assistant.overview.scaffold: Scaffold or no readable source content; this is not a completion score.
assistant.overview.partial: Only local read-only facts and shown excerpts. No runtime, compile or model call is started. A brief overview is included only in authorized project requests.
assistant.whole.title: Confirm whole-project reading
assistant.whole.description: Review the actual readable saved files, exclusions and estimated request capacity. No model call has been made. Confirmation sends this exact admitted range.
assistant.whole.estimate: Estimated request tokens: {{tokens}} · {{bytes}} UTF-8 bytes. This is an estimate, not provider usage.
assistant.whole.alternative: Ask a focused question or read relevant file sections instead.
assistant.whole.defaultInput: Read the whole admitted saved project. Explain its structure, evidence gaps and next questions without treating it as runtime or artistic validation.
assistant.project.snapshotText: View the snapshot used in this request
assistant.project.navigation.changed: The current file differs from this snapshot. The original request text remains above.
assistant.project.navigation.unavailable: This saved source cannot be opened under the current project reading rules.
assistant.proposal.capability.live: Declared live parameter; preview requires the matching running project.
assistant.proposal.capability.refresh: Requires a manual page refresh after saving.
assistant.proposal.capability.restart: Requires a manual restart after saving.
assistant.proposal.capability.unsupporte: No live adapter declared. Code editing and explicit application remain available.
assistant.proposal.bindingUnavailable: This code cannot currently bind to verified controls. Edit/apply code, or clarify the target; no values are guessed.
assistant.proposal.scope: One existing text file. Candidate edits and preview do not save, check, refresh or restart the project. Highlighting is not execution or validation.
assistant.proposal.discardCandidate: Discard this entire edited candidate? File drafts and saved files are kept. Cancel keeps the candidate.
assistant.proposal.manualRecovery: Parameters were not confirmed restored. Use the existing manual refresh/restart controls and verify the project; elapsed time and prior effects cannot be undone.
assistant.proposal.partial: Partial preview only. Other code changes and these controls were not previewed: {{ids}}
assistant.proposal.observed: Adapter observed values: {{values}}. This is not a complete code check.
assistant.proposal.previewState.checking: Verifying preview binding and actual loaded version…
assistant.proposal.previewState.temporar: Temporary parameters active on this monitor; candidate is not saved or checked.
assistant.proposal.previewState.ended: Temporary parameter baselines restored. Prior effects and elapsed time remain.
assistant.proposal.previewState.failed: Preview did not complete. Code editing and explicit application remain available.
assistant.proposal.previewState.unrestor: Restoration not confirmed; manual action required.
assistant.proposal.previewProblem.unavai: No supported live values or matching running monitor. Start the project manually if needed.
assistant.proposal.previewProblem.incomp: The project adapter is incompatible. Use code editing or a confirmed adaptation handoff.
assistant.proposal.previewProblem.loaded: Saved source, adapter or actual loaded version differs. Reload source and manually refresh/restart as appropriate.
assistant.proposal.previewProblem.feedba: The adapter did not confirm the requested effect.
assistant.proposal.previewProblem.timeou: No matching adapter feedback before the timeout.
assistant.proposal.previewProblem.restor: Restoration failed or its result is unknown.
assistant.check.independent: Checks saved files only; chatting, previewing and saving never start a check.
assistant.check.failure: Changes are kept. Choose whether to edit, undo the last guarded save or prepare a handoff. No automatic repair or adoption of copy outputs.
assistant.check.handoffConfirm: Prepare an editable handoff for external work? This does not run an agent, write the handoff, change files or send a model request. Review it before choosing Record.
assistant.check.handoffIntent: Investigate controlled check {{task}} ({{mode}}). Preserve current edits; review the complete copied report and actual saved inputs before proposing a repair.
assistant.check.handoffAcceptance: Reference check: {{task}}. Confirm scope and input versions with the creator. Do not automatically adopt copy outputs or repeatedly repair. Require an explicit new application and an independent new check; rendered pages and sound need manual verification.
assistant.proposal.handoffIntent: Discuss complex changes or missing preview adaptation for {{path}}. Confirm scope before changing the project; do not split cross-file work into individual proposals.
creation.handoff.reviewHint: This confirmation is bound to the current project and saved file versions. Changes require a fresh review.
assistant.handoff.title: External handoff preview
assistant.handoff.ask: Hand this work to an external agent? Review the task before recording it.
creation.handoff.draftHint: Choose which saved version to hand off. Save first handles file drafts only; pending suggestions and temporary preview are not applied. A handoff document draft is preserved and may conflict with the newly recorded task.
creation.handoff.waitForSave: Wait for the current save or rename, then review again.
creation.handoff.baselineFailed: Task recorded, but the comparison baseline is not complete. Retry from the baseline list; its captured origin is retained.
creation.handoff.taskFailed: Task was not recorded. The captured origin is retained; resolve the error and retry.
creation.handoff.baselineReady: Saved-file comparison baseline recorded. This is not a project or resource backup.
handoff.baselines.title: Changes since handoff
handoff.baselines.hint: Baselines compare saved files independently of Git. Drafts, pending suggestions and temporary preview are excluded. Resources have fingerprints only; baselines cannot restore the project. Clearing chat does not delete them. Verify actual effects yourself.
handoff.baselines.empty: No handoff baselines for this project.
handoff.baselines.incomplete: Handoff comparison is incomplete. Resolve the error and retry this captured origin.
handoff.baselines.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this comparison baseline? Project files and tasks are preserved.
handoff.compare.localOnly: These are changes since handoff, including any manual edits. Comparison is local and read-only; no content is sent to the model. It does not verify appearance, interaction or sound, or mark the task complete.
handoff.compare.stale: Saved files changed. This comparison is out of date; refresh before drawing conclusions.
handoff.compare.unchanged: No changes in the compared saved files. Check the exclusions for uncovered content.
handoff.compare.drafts: Unsaved drafts are preserved separately and are not included in this disk comparison.
handoff.exclusion.dependencyOrBuild: Dependency, build output, cache or Git data
handoff.operation.publishing: Finishing the confirmed task and baseline; writing can no longer be cancelled.
handoff.operation.cancelled: Collection cancelled; any already captured origin is retained.
creation.version.newScope: Before creating this project, PNDS records its generated code, configuration, documentation and ordinary resources as “Initial project”. Dependencies, caches, App data and secrets are excluded. Media/model files of 10 MiB or more are excluded by default; files over 64 MiB are unsupported. Git remains local and does not run the project.
creation.version.name: Version author name
creation.version.placeholder: An empty email uses creator@pnds.local, a local placeholder. This identity only applies to this repository and is independent of the project creator.
creation.version.policy: Whole saved files only. Follow .gitignore; dependencies, caches, App data and secrets are excluded. Media/model files ≥10 MiB are unselected by default, but can be included. Each file is limited to 64 MiB; collection to 256 MiB. Already tracked resources remain visible. Git history grows with included resources.
creation.version.confirmHint: Record only these saved files with this message and identity. Unsaved drafts, unapplied proposals and temporary previews are excluded.
creation.version.resultScope: This is a saved-file record. Running pages, sound and checks are unchanged; test explicitly.
creation.version.growth: Selected saved content: {{size}} MiB. Each version can increase local history storage.
creation.version.staged: External staged content: handle this file with an external Git tool first.
creation.version.exclusion.largeMedia: Large media/model: excluded by default; explicitly select to include.
creation.version.exclusion.tooLarge: Over 64 MiB: use an external Git tool.
creation.version.exclusion.ignored: Excluded by existing Git ignore rules.
creation.version.pending: {{count}} change proposals remain separate. Temporary preview: {{preview}}. Neither is saved or included.
creation.history.limit: Shows at most the most recent 30 project commits, following up to 300 first-parent commits from HEAD. Merge changes compare the first parent.
creation.history.more: More history exists or the scan limit was reached. Use an external Git tool for the rest.
creation.history.draft: Current unsaved draft: saved content → draft
creation.history.scope: Load only this existing text into the editor draft. Disk, HEAD, index and running pages stay as they are. Explicit save still checks current disk changes and content rules.
creation.history.replaceHint: This file has a draft. Keep it, cancel, or explicitly replace it with the selected historical text.
creation.history.loaded: Historical text loaded into draft. Save and test explicitly.
creation.history.changed: The project, target, draft or saved version changed. Review the historical file again.
creation.history.reason.missingHistory: This path is absent in the selected commit. It cannot be loaded.
creation.history.reason.missingCurrent: The current file no longer exists. Loading does not restore deleted files.
creation.history.reason.notRegular: A directory, symbolic link or submodule cannot be loaded into a text draft.
creation.history.reason.binary: Binary or unsupported historical content: summary only.
creation.history.reason.unsupportedText: Current or historical content is not supported editable UTF-8 text.
creation.history.reason.tooLarge: Content exceeds the 1 MiB text limit. Use an external Git tool.
creation.history.reason.notEditable: This project source is read-only. History cannot be loaded into an editable draft.
